about.subtitle: Painting, remodeling, cleaning and ongoing maintenance — one team for everything your home needs.
about.p1: CSD Good Services is a Miami home services company. We started in 2014 with residential painting — and over the years our clients asked us to handle the rest.
about.p2: Today we offer painting, remodeling, cleaning and ongoing maintenance — coordinated by one team so you only have to make one call.
about.team_subtitle: Reliable professionals with years of experience in their craft.
about.value_1_desc: Professional crews with years of experience. The same faces show up every time.
about.value_2_desc: Scheduled visits, on-time arrivals, and clear timelines. We tell you when something changes.
about.value_3_desc: Painting, remodeling, cleaning and maintenance coordinated by a single point of contact.
about.value_4_desc: Call, text or email. We respond within one business day, every time.
about.editorial_quote: One team for everything your home needs. Painting, remodeling, cleaning and maintenance — coordinated, reliable, easy.
about.service_painting_desc: Repaints, color changes, accent walls and full finish work for homes and businesses.
about.service_remodeling_desc: From a quick refresh to a full renovation — coordinated start to finish.
about.service_cleaning_desc: Deep cleaning inside and out — windows, high ceilings, pools and shared spaces.
about.service_bathroom_desc: Tile, plumbing, fixtures and finishes for full bathroom transformations.
about.service_pressure_desc: Driveways, patios, decks, sidewalks and exterior walls — cleaned and restored.
about.service_maintenance_desc: Recurring repairs, drywall patches, touch-ups and small jobs handled the same week.

process.step_1_desc: We visit the space, listen to what you need and document the scope. Free of charge.
process.step_2_desc: A clear quote with timeline, materials and what's included. You know exactly what to expect.
process.step_3_desc: Professional crew, daily progress, clean job site. You know what's happening every day.
process.step_4_desc: We inspect the work together, close the punch list and hand over warranty documents.
